description: The Lualaba River hydropower cascade and related energy megaprojects

projects.name: Nzilo I
projects.role: first stage of the cascade, provides scale context

projects.name: Zongo II
projects.grid_role: unlike Busanga, feeds directly into the national grid serving western DRC

projects.name: Busanga
projects.general_contractor: Power China Engineering (Sinohydro + China Railway Resources Group)
projects.financing: China Eximbank, commercial loan at 6.1% p.a. (2016); $567m for the plant, ~$50m for the 13.15km 500kV transmission line
projects.social_environmental_cost: 3 villages flooded, 3 more lost farmland; complaints about compensation and lack of electricity access for resettled people

projects.name: Nzilo II / 'Heshima' project
projects.location: Lualaba River, ~40-60 km from Kolwezi (between Nzilo I and Nseke/Busanga)
partners: Lualaba Power S.A. (JV of Mining Engineering Services + SNEL)
projects.2025_status: construction site confirmed by the minister on 2025-10-04
projects.purpose: power CMOC's planned growth to 800k-1m t/year of copper by 2028

projects.name: Grand Inga (Chinese participation)
projects.phase_1_inga_3: 15.5 sq.km reservoir, diversion into a Bundi tributary
projects.chinese_involvement: Chinese corporations and Eximbank alongside the World Bank
projects.risks: flooding of tropical forest, forced displacement of ~30,000 people
projects.verification_status: not independently re-verified this round - carried over from the user's original document, the $250m figure specifically warrants further checking

summary.purpose: almost all generation is earmarked for mining consortiums, not the region's residents
